ValidationRule.description: This will check the Start Time of the RBM interaction is within a certain range(3 months in past and 1 Year in future)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c =false, RecordType.DeveloperName = "RBM_Broker_Interaction", OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(StartTime) ), OR( StartTime < ADDMONTHS(NOW(), -3), StartTime > ADDMONTHS(NOW(), 12) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Start Time must be within the last 3 months and not more than 1 year in the future.
